blind.description: A stylized, hand-painted cartoon apple tree featuring a thick, gnarled brown trunk with flared roots, a curved branch, and several puffy, rounded clumps of green foliage. Bright red apples with tiny brown stems sit nestled atop and along the sides of the leaf clusters. Surfaces are completely solid, smooth, and continuous with no hovering elements, cracks, or holes.
blind.from_above: From directly above, it appears as a cluster of rounded, overlapping green canopy puffs arranged in a circular formation, dotted with bright red apples, with a small portion of the twisted trunk visible beneath the gaps.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 1.3 times the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure, with a canopy width approximately 1.4 times the figure's height.
